note: Card 063's record. Not a findings artifact, for the reason in card061-e2e-run-20261006-e2e061b.json: findings.schema.json describes deliveries to the librarian only. Nothing here is for the store, and every TEST value is cited with its scratch path.

items.fact: Part A at b6a4ef7, after 088b900 (live view) and a390c73 (drawable mock frames). Already there before it: the gate and walk (055, fee80a0) and the copied core (059, f2c56dc).
items.how: Built: focus_decider.MetricMaximumDecider, operator.run running a focus_search plan, a camera ceiling that is a gap refusing before any Z, and operator.run(root=...) refused off mock before anything is read. 7 test cases, watched failing at import, and 6 deliberate breaks each caught.

items.fact: check_88_focus_search, pointed at the scratch envelope and store, PASSES plan-mic-test063-focus40x: a search over 95..110 um at 40x, inside the TEST 90..110 um, with the ceiling citing kb:TEST_mock_camera_full_scale. It also passes the ceiling-gap plan, saying it cannot run until the store holds the count. It FAILS the 20x plan: no focus_z_20x limits. Re-run after ce65cc1, with the TEST store entry carrying full_scale_count 65535 ADU and depth of field recorded as the gap depth_of_field_mock: PASS for the 40x plan and for the gap plan.
items.how: envelope_files and KB_DIR were pointed into the scratch root and the plans passed as a stand-in bundle. This measures the plans, and is not a validator run over this repository.

items.fact: The first walk, run-20261007-063-s2-search (sha256 88c5b8ffbc913bdb06c5e4dee39e202070cd1d1adf8ad888f401dd62b6e974c3), refused at the PFS check with no Z command. Nothing then recorded which PFS reading means not engaged, and the plan schema had no field for the verdict's thresholds.
items.how: manager-microscope settled both at 0e3eff1: focus_search.verdict_thresholds, and the envelope's pfs_not_engaged. This seat followed at a06ed2f. The scratch envelope then carried a TEST pfs_not_engaged {PFS, State, [Off]}, and the mock's PFS was set by the harness.

items.fact:
The focus search on mock: run-20261007-063-s2c-search, events.jsonl sha256 25ec3c97efa52625e7401371b671b931cecf8926e9d920b2ee1f62749e00cf45. Each decision, by the copied core over the walk's own frames:
- 95 um (retract, read 95): score 0.123, core unsure (too few frames), decider step_up
- 100 (read 100): 0.349, unsure, step_up
- 105 (read 105): 0.398, core step_up
- 110 (read 110): 0.349, core in_focus at its frame at 105, decider step_down
- 105 (read 105): 0.398, in_focus
It ended found at 105.0 um, the encoder read. Every target was compared live against the TEST focus_z_40x_max 110 and was within it. run_ended: completed.
items.how: TEST values: mock frames 64 x 64 whose structure peaks at the mock's FOCUS_Z_UM = 105 (53d9a44); the TEST envelope and ceiling under D:/sma-scratch/063. The decider's step_up while frames are fewer than min_frames is its own choice, recorded on each decision.

items.fact: The walk's first run with both fields, run-20261007-063-s2b-search (sha256 c363a2f0fc5b84e5e0cfb21f507f2de65df8463457a7b2f211777335b160a056), ended found at 110 um, one step past the mock's focus at 105. At 110 the core said in_focus naming its frame at 105, and the decider passed in_focus through.
items.how: Fixed at 0d4a835: in_focus only once the core's frame is the current read; otherwise a step toward it. run-20261007-063-s2c-search is the walk after the fix.

items.how: PFS on: run-20261007-063-s3e-pfson, sha256 15f2d61ad04e7e8ce334b3a5f3b6fed61c5f1287d057d97607e8b7c9325a3334, 'PFS reads PFS.State = On, not one of [Off]', no Z command. Above the max: run-20261007-063-s3g-abovemax, sha256 a56a5874c9f20d1f9982a3fedb2d8539533267ebc363f8e9ef62e40147792029, mock focus at 112. The walk rose 95, 100, 105, 110 (each read back), the core said step_up at 110, and the derived target 115 was compared against focus_z_40x_max 110 (compared true, within false) and refused before it went out: 'target 115.0 um is above focus_z_40x_max 110.0 um'. The last encoder read stayed 110, and no readback exists for 115. An earlier attempt with focus at 130 (run-20261007-063-s3f-abovemax, f813b6561f63409bcfafbf4d50c4c392fa9c443cc3a49a347dfb2c68a5b5d8c3) never reached the limit: the curve was flat, the core said unsure at 105, and the search ended unsure. The console listed the failed runs.

items.fact: Abort from the console mid-run: run-20261007-live-223424925, events.jsonl sha256 e81cb8c857c5cc20f45f61472445259636d28236326c712b1c51615be5d8568a. The lamp was on and frames were coming. The stop's reason was 'the dino console: card 063 step 4'. Then abort_begin, abort_end, the lights off (Aura III and DiaLamp commanded 0, read 0), both turret shutters closed, csuw1_shutter not commanded, laser_shutter sent {enable: []} and not confirmed. The sequence stopped at 170 of 6000 frames, aborted, none written to disk. run_ended: stopped_from_outside at t_mono 17.438. No command after the stop.
items.how: Live on was classified started and the Abort begun, both the console session's report. log.json equals the stream between run_started and run_ended.

items.fact: On mock, four rows read true in steps 1 and 4: Aura III and DiaLamp matched, and both turret shutters closed. Mock cannot have confirmed them: it echoes the value it was given. The live-view lamp writes are also marked readback for the same reason.
items.how: The same disagreement as card 061: card 054's test requires the mock rows to be true, and cards 061 and 063 call a true row on mock a defect. Not changed here; it is the card author's to settle.

items.fact: A run refused inside operator.run (s2, s3a, s3b, s3d) leaves events.jsonl, ending run_ended failed, and no log.json: run() raises, so the record is never returned to be written. Under check 15's in-flight rule (b829aaa), such a folder in the tree would read as a run in flight, forever.
items.how: Seen in all four scratch folders. Not fixed here: whether a refused run writes its log, and in what shape, is a manager's call about check 15 and the run log.
